summary: Shinhan Financial Group filed a Form 6-K (the US-equivalent disclosure for a foreign private issuer, analogous to a US current report) announcing completion of its treasury share buyback program commenced July 23, 2026. It acquired 6,538,515 common shares over July 31–October 16, 2026 at an average KRW 107,058 per share, totaling KRW 699,999,932,500, with final settlement October 20, 2026. Treasury shares now equal 1.39% of issued common shares, excluding one fractional-share holding. No advisor or board recommendation disclosed. Watch cancellation intent and overhang.
